children.title: Observe Track Ahead and External Signals

ttaRecords.recovery: ETCS automatic traction cutout & warning alert
ttaRecords.comments: Driver over-throttled while accelerating out of a neutral section.

ttaRecords.recovery: Driver manual throttle notch back upon crossing speed board
ttaRecords.consequence: Minor speed restriction violation, schedule delay
ttaRecords.comments: Driver misjudged deceleration distance needed for heavy freight trailing load.

ttaRecords.recovery: ETCS automatic full service brake application
ttaRecords.consequence: Risk of SPAD (Signal Passed At Danger) or overshoot of movement authority
ttaRecords.comments: Driver missed braking point due to reduced visibility and distraction.

ttaRecords.recovery: Signalling center intervention via GSM-R call
ttaRecords.consequence: Unplanned train stop on mainline corridor, minor network delay
ttaRecords.comments: Misinterpretation of degraded mode rules during emergency bypass authorization.

ttaRecords.recovery: Driver Safety Device (DSD) / Deadman's pedal alarm
ttaRecords.consequence: Delayed recognition of restrictive signal aspect ahead
ttaRecords.comments: Lapse in visual scanning routine during long night shift passage.

ttaRecords.recovery: Visual re-check triggered by ETCS audio chime
ttaRecords.consequence: Inappropriate target speed selection relative to Movement Authority (MA)
ttaRecords.comments: Direct sunlight glare on screen caused digit misread on target distance indicator.

ttaRecords.recovery: Immediate emergency brake initiation by driver
ttaRecords.consequence: Reduced safety buffer before hazardous track condition or signal
ttaRecords.comments: Heavy downpour restricted sightline distance to physical wayside boards.

ttaRecords.recovery: Signaller warning broadcast over GSM-R cab radio
ttaRecords.consequence: Entering temporary speed restriction (TSR) zone at normal track speed
ttaRecords.comments: Driver distracted by secondary radio communication while approaching TSR marker.

ttaRecords.recovery: Rapid brake re-application upon observing signal state
ttaRecords.comments: Driver anticipated signal clearing based on daily routine timetable.
